summary: Persist and resume the Classic books-list leg independently of export.
reason: Classic export and books-list form one resumable chain. Persist the drained export before list requests; a foreign list row must never discard the export cursor or watermark. Bind continuation to chain scope and page size, overlap the last good page, and restart only when that resumed page is missing, using the original page budget. Completion requires a list client, atomically clears continuation, preserves export/highlight counts and the original chain watermark, and records books total_count from actual stored rows. Latest-only walks upsert through real command routing while preserving every checkpoint field. These Readwise-specific behaviors belong in the downstream customization; generic fixture isolation belongs upstream in Printing Press.
markers: books-list client is required to complete export sync
